summary: Regression + auto-save verification for MovieEdit/SeriesEdit save flow. All acceptance criteria in the review request pass: no 'Save failed' toast anywhere; top-save-btn and bottom-save-btn on both movie and series produce a 200 PATCH and 'Changes saved' toast; debounced auto-save fires ~900ms after last input, shows 'Unsaved changes…' -> 'Saving…' -> 'All changes saved' and resets to blank ~1.6s later; no spurious PATCH on page load; changes persist across reload (verified via GET); cast add via 'Add cast' dialog + Enter on new person creates the row (#N badge visible) with no Save failed toast.

issues: Console: 'validateDOMNesting: <button> cannot appear as a descendant of <button>' — the season header <button> (SeriesEdit.jsx ~L587) wraps a shadcn <Button> remove-season control (~L593). Unrelated to the save bug but should be refactored to a <div role=button> or move the remove button out of the header button. Causes hydration warnings, not a blocker.

action_items: Optional: refactor nested <button> in SeriesEdit.jsx (season header ~L587 contains Button ~L593) to remove hydration warning.
Optional: series PATCH takes ~3s under load; if UX-sensitive, consider partial-payload PATCH instead of resending full seasons array on every auto-save.
critical_code_review_comments: save() guard using Array.isArray(overrideForm.cast/main_cast) is correct and defensively rejects SyntheticEvent args — fix is solid.

Auto-save useEffect skips save when `saving` is true; because savedFormRef only advances on success, the next form mutation will re-trigger — acceptable but could result in stale-typed content flush; low priority.
MovieEdit auto-save silent path does NOT call setStats within the save handler when an exception occurs (only success path). Fine as-is.

Final movie tagline='...TESTTOP BOTTOM' + reloaded auto-tagline 'AUTO_...'; final series tagline='S_AUTO_..._BOT'. Cast add created a new actor 'TestActor_<ts>' attached to the movie.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The debounced auto-save wait window should be >=4s for series (payload is heavy due to full seasons resend). Movie auto-save completes in ~1.5-2s. Watch for the DOM-nesting warning in SeriesEdit season header if refactoring — that predates this bug fix.
rca of the issue: Root cause: <Button onClick={save}> passes React SyntheticEvent as the first arg to save(overrideForm). save() then called overrideForm.cast.filter(...) which threw because SyntheticEvent has no .cast, triggering the catch and the 'Save failed' toast — even though no PATCH was ever attempted. Fix (verified): onClick={() => save()} on both top/bottom buttons and defensive guard `Array.isArray(overrideForm.cast|main_cast)` before treating the arg as a form override. Additionally, a JSON-diff based debounced auto-save (900ms) with a savedFormRef snapshot was added, wired to an autosave-status indicator (data-testid=autosave-status).
